local_changes: Unused and duplicate imports removed; comprehension names are descriptive.
An unknown cached presence verdict is typed explicitly.
Unbilled endpoints are classified by exact localhost and parsed private IP literals.
Docstrings describe the portable drop-in contract only.
A non-UTF-8 env file is treated as unreadable.
No built-in subscription policy: a caller registers one with set_policy(), and a refused drop-in is logged by name.
The bearer is chosen by wire in key_for(), shared with one-cli's own reader.
A non-HTTP answer (http.client.HTTPException) is an unreachable endpoint, and malformed relay model metadata is absent.
